description: Call this FIRST when the user refers to a project, vehicle, property, client or topic by name and you do not already know its brains project slug. Turns freeform context into the project slug plus the path to its instruction file, so you can pull the right project instead of guessing a tag. Returns ranked matches with a confidence and an `ambiguous` flag — when ambiguous is true or confidence is low, ask the user rather than loading a project. Does not load anything itself: follow up with pull_session_bundle(folder: "projects/<slug>").
name: resolve_project
